summary: Clearwater NF site: 1935 camp, 1937 30 ft pole L-4 tower, 20 ft L-6 patrol tower nearby; listed as ruins, one Idaho list says tower gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as Ruins by firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the June 2016 Forest Service list. A firelookout.org list says Tower Gone.

events.note: Camp on the site before the tower was built
30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab; 20-foot L-6 patrol tower half a mile southwest
Forest Service list compiled June 2016 gives the site as Ruins

evidence.supports: 1935 camp; 1937 30 ft pole L-4 tower; 20 ft L-6 patrol tower half a mile southwest; ruins
evidence.quote: 1935: camp. 1937: 30' pole L-4 tower. 20' L-6 patrol tower 1/2 mile southwest. Ruins.

evidence.supports: location 18 miles northeast of Pierce, Clearwater County, Idaho
1937 30 ft pole tower with L-4 cab
20 ft L-6 patrol tower half a mile southwest
Forest Service list gives 1937 and Ruins for Big Horn Point
Forest Service list places the site in section 21, township 38 north
Forest Service list compiled by Margaret Sand
firelookout.org list labels the tower Tower Gone
evidence.quote: Big Horn Point Clearwater 46.62261 -115.45154 Tower Gone

sources.title: Big Horn Point Fire Lookout Tower

corrections.why: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both name the Clearwater National Forest. 'National Forest' is generic.
Three sources describe the site as Ruins. Only the firelookout.org list says Tower Gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.org's Idaho list says Tower Gone; firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the June 2016 Forest Service list say Ruins. The record reports ruins and notes the dissent.

notes_for_editor: The brief had no design or height; L-4 and 30 ft (9.1 m) come from firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. No source documents staffing. Elevation 4,659 ft is from firelookout.com. Hike-in access is from idahofirelookouts.com only. No photos found. Proposed status and agency corrections are for the editor to accept or reject.
